answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. A sonnet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nadir of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the karst of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
